thread.title: UPDATE: Dow drops nearly 400 points to start Thanksgiving week; Boeing, Apple deliver biggest intraday blows

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Dow drops nearly 400 points to start Thanksgiving week; Boeing, Apple deliver biggest intraday blows
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was sinking late-morning Monday, pressured by a decline in Boeing Co.'s stock (BA) and Apple Inc. to start the holiday-shortened week. Boeing shares were exacting a roughly 90-point toll from the price-weighted blue-chip gauge, which was trading 400 points, or 1.6%, at 25,016, at last check. The S&P 500 index declined 1.6% at 2,693, while the Nasdaq Composite Index lost 2.6% at 7,060, with a drop in shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) subtracting about 50 points from the Dow and the market market. The Wall Street Journal over the weekend reported that production slowdowns at the iPhone maker were hurting its suppliers. Shares of Apple were down about 3.7%.
-Mark DeCambre; 1157ET
